a1-drawing-the-circle.svg: Drawing the circle. Blind (3/3): compass mid-circle comes through large, but at a glance it reads as a clock or gauge hand (3/3), and at 16px as a 'no' sign (1/3). No A. Weight uneven: thin circle, heavy legs.
a2-refined.svg: Refined A. Blind (3/3): compass and letter A both read; all three named it the one they'd remember, and it holds at 16px. Echoes to manage: arc ends past the legs read as a moustache or handlebars (2/3); a faint Masonic and Avengers echo (1/3). Round 3 fix: trim the arc ends to the legs.
